objective: Minimize the number of additional synthetic observations needed to resolve four SG027-unresolved trends while preserving matched no-drift controls and immutable evidence.

sources.comparison: SG028 fixed 240 additional observations per case
sources.controls: Same seeds, noise and step, but injected drift set to zero.

protocol.acquisition: Observe t=240 onward in blocks of 40, at most 240 new observations; no lookahead or retrospective sampling
protocol.estimator: For each available prefix with at least 80 observations, split into contiguous nonoverlapping 10-observation bins; take median of pairwise bin-median slopes, indexed at bin centers
protocol.decisions: rejected if |slope| < 0.0018; confirmed if |slope| > 0.0032; else unresolved
protocol.stop: Two consecutive eligible checkpoints with the same non-unresolved decision; otherwise acquire the next 40 observations. No forced decision at cap
protocol.cost: 1 unit per observation; 8 cases × 240 = 1920 fixed benchmark units; charged on acquired observations even if unresolved
protocol.score: Correctly resolved true drifts, correctly rejected no-drift controls, wrong decisions, unresolved cases at cap, observations used, savings vs fixed benchmark
protocol.ledger: Append-only snapshot for prior unresolved, each 40-observation batch with SHA256 digest, each interim classification, and final status; do not overwrite SG027/028 history

limitations: Not a statistical confidence interval or an optimal economic decision rule
Designed on same four known synthetic seed families and known noise distribution as SG028, thus not fresh independent holdout
No explicit financial loss model; observation cost is an illustrative unit cost
Safety of stopping is empirical, not formally guaranteed
